0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4""".split('\n')],float)
GO,GE=-11.0,-1.0
def oh(p):
    C=np.zeros((len(p[0]),20))
    for s in p:
        for i,c in enumerate(s):
            if c in AI: C[i,AI[c]]+=1
    return C
def al(P,Q):
    CP,CQ=oh(P),oh(Q); den=np.outer(CP.sum(1),CQ.sum(1)); den[den==0]=1
    S=(CP@BM@CQ.T)/den; m,n=len(P[0]),len(Q[0]); NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((m+1,n+1),NEG);Ix=M.copy();Iy=M.copy();tb=np.zeros((m+1,n+1,3),np.int8);M[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,m+1): Ix[i,0]=GO+GE*(i-1);tb[i,0,1]=1
    for j in range(1,n+1): Iy[0,j]=GO+GE*(j-1);tb[0,j,2]=2
    for i in range(1,m+1):
        for j in range(1,n+1):
            v=(M[i-1,j-1],Ix[i-1,j-1],Iy[i-1,j-1]);k=int(np.argmax(v));M[i,j]=v[k]+S[i-1,j-1];tb[i,j,0]=k
            v=(M[i-1,j]+GO,Ix[i-1,j]+GE,Iy[i-1,j]+GO);k=int(np.argmax(v));Ix[i,j]=v[k];tb[i,j,1]=k
            v=(M[i,j-1]+GO,Ix[i,j-1]+GO,Iy[i,j-1]+GE);k=int(np.argmax(v));Iy[i,j]=v[k];tb[i,j,2]=k
    i,j=m,n;st=int(np.argmax([M[m,n],Ix[m,n],Iy[m,n]]));pa=[];qa=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i==0: pa.append(None);qa.append(j-1);j-=1;continue
        if j==0: pa.append(i-1);qa.append(None);i-=1;continue
        if st==0: pa.append(i-1);qa.append(j-1);ns=tb[i,j,0];i-=1;j-=1
        elif st==1: pa.append(i-1);qa.append(None);ns=tb[i,j,1];i-=1
        else: pa.append(None);qa.append(j-1);ns=tb[i,j,2];j-=1
        st=int(ns)
    pa.reverse();qa.reverse()
    return [''.join(p[k] if k is not None else '-' for k in pa) for p in P]+[''.join(q[k] if k is not None else '-' for k in qa) for q in Q]
ACC={'Yet1_Sc':'P35723','Yet2_Sc':'Q04210','Yet3_Sc':'Q07451','BAP29_Hs':'Q9UHQ4','BAP31_Hs':'P51572'}
SEQ={k:''.join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{v}.fasta",timeout=60).text.split('\n')[1:]) for k,v in ACC.items()}
P1=al([SEQ['BAP29_Hs']],[SEQ['BAP31_Hs']]); P2=al([SEQ['Yet1_Sc']],[SEQ['Yet2_Sc']])
P3=al(P2,[SEQ['Yet3_Sc']]); FIN=al(P1,P3)
MSA=dict(zip(['BAP29_Hs','BAP31_Hs','Yet1_Sc','Yet2_Sc','Yet3_Sc'],FIN))
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def ifc(pid,c1,c2,cut=5.0):
    at=defaultdict(list)
    for L in requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{pid}.pdb",timeout=60).text.split('\n'):
        if L.startswith(('ATOM  ','HETATM')) and L[17:20].strip() in AA3 and L[16] in ' A':
            at[L[21]].append((int(L[22:26]),AA3[L[17:20].strip()],np.array([float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54])])))
    A,B=at[c1],at[c2]
    D=np.linalg.norm(np.array([a[2] for a in A])[:,None]-np.array([b[2] for b in B])[None],axis=2)
    r=defaultdict(int)
    for i,j in zip(*np.where(D<cut)): r[(A[i][0],A[i][1])]+=1
    return dict(r)

r31=sorted(x[0] for x in I31); aa31={x[0]:x[1] for x in I31}
A31=[r for r in r31 if (r-181)%7==0]; D31=[r for r in r31 if (r-177)%7==0]

        ch=MSA[n][col]; row[n]=f"{ch}{sum(1 for x in MSA[n][:col+1] if x!='-')}" if ch!='-' else '—'
        row[n+'_b']=float(BM[AI[aa],AI[ch]]) if ch in AI else np.nan
    rows.append(row)
df=pd.DataFrame(rows); df.to_csv('/tmp/iface_map.csv',index=False)
